name: number-input
title: Number Input
summary: A number field with buttons to step the value down and up.
description: A number field with a minus and a plus button inside its end. The field is the Input (the shared control's sizes and looks: its fill, hairline, focus and invalid rings, 16px text on touch) and the buttons are ghost Buttons laid over the room kept at its end. Arrow keys step, Shift + arrow ten steps, Home / End go to the bounds; a button held down repeats. The value can be formatted (currency, percent) with Intl options. Behaviour by Ark UI's number-input (Zag). Controlled or uncontrolled.

anatomy.description: Ark's number-input root: a column, the label above the control. As wide as its container (give it a width).
Visible name (the label prop): text.sm, medium, ink, as the Field's label. It wraps, never truncates.
Holds the field and the two buttons laid over its end.
The Input (data-number-input="input"): role=spinbutton, tabular figures, its end padded for the buttons (xs 42px, sm 48px, md 56px, lg 60px).

The Button (data-number-input="decrement-trigger"): ghost, muted, rounded, square, with a minus; xs 18px, sm 20px, md and lg 24px. Out of the tab order; disabled at the minimum. Held down it repeats. On a coarse pointer its hit area is 40px high.
The Button (data-number-input="increment-trigger") with a plus, at the very end: as the decrement trigger; disabled at the maximum.

value.description: The text of the field ("12"; "" when empty). onValueChange also gives the number.

min.description: Lower bound: the minus button is disabled there, and a typed value below it is clamped on blur.

size.description: The Input's sizes (`lib/control.ts`): xs 24px field and 18px buttons, sm 28px and 20px, md 32px and 24px, lg 36px and 24px.

variant.description: The shared control's looks (`lib/control.ts`), at every size. outline: the form field (field colour, hairline). subtle: the inspector (inset grey, no edge). ghost: nothing until touched. Focused, open and invalid look the same in every variant.

formatOptions.description: Intl.NumberFormat options for the shown value (style currency / percent, grouping, fraction digits).

allowMouseWheel.description: The wheel steps the value while the field has focus.

decrementLabel.description: Accessible name of the minus button.

incrementLabel.description: Accessible name of the plus button.

events.valueChange: (value: string, valueAsNumber: number) on every change
events.valueCommit: (value: string, valueAsNumber: number) after Enter, a blur or a step

keyboard: Arrow Up / Arrow Down: one step up / down; with Shift ten steps
Home / End: the minimum / the maximum (when set)
Enter: settles the typed value (formatted and clamped)
The buttons are out of the tab order: the arrow keys do what they do
notes: The field is role=spinbutton with aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, aria-valuenow and aria-roledescription "numberfield".
Name it with label (visible) or aria-label; the buttons are named by decrementLabel / incrementLabel and point at the field (aria-controls).
The text is 16px on touch devices (the Input's rule), so iOS does not zoom.
To set it from outside, control `value`: React value / onValueChange.

motion: the Input's: rings over duration.base, fill over duration.fast (pointer hover only)
the Buttons': press scales to motion.press-scale; hover fill over duration.fast (pointer only)
the value changes in place, instantly
